Diesel hits $6 a gallon for the first time, fueling more inflation
The national average price of a gallon of  diesel  jumped over $6 for the first time ever, AAA said on Friday.   Why it matters:  The fuel that runs the economy is getting more expensive by the day, costing businesses and consumers alike billions of dollars.     While the $6 threshold is more psychological than anything else, it points to months of continued pain for drivers, shippers and shoppers.    Data: AAA; Chart: Ben Geman/Axios   Driving the news:  At $6.0556   a gallon, diesel is about 14% more expensive than it was a month ago and over 60% more than a year ago.    That is starting to show up in other prices, as has long been feared; inflation data out Thursday showed  sharp spikes

伊朗说美国是最大干涉者和破坏者
伊朗外交部发言人巴加埃9月11日接受伊朗国家电视台采访时表示，美国一直是地区和平的最大干涉者和最大破坏者，“他们希望伊斯兰国家之间的动荡持续下去”。巴加埃表示，伊朗与地区各国之间的对话至关重要，地区国家需要依靠自身而不是外部力量来保障安全。
针对也门局势，巴加埃表示，也门当前发生的一切表明，也门民众的耐心已经耗尽，因为也门民众长期遭受残酷围困，被剥夺了一个正常国家应有的基本权益，他们认为联合国和区域机制无法改善局势，所以决定打破围困。（CCTV国际时讯）
items.title: 伊朗说美国是最大干涉者和破坏者

Diesel hits $6 a gallon for the first time, fueling more inflation
The national average price of a gallon of  diesel  jumped over $6 for the first time ever, AAA said on Friday.   Why it matters:  The fuel that runs the economy is getting more expensive by the day, costing businesses and consumers alike billions of dollars.     While the $6 threshold is more psychological than anything else, it points to months of continued pain for drivers, shippers and shoppers.    Data: AAA; Chart: Ben Geman/Axios   Driving the news:  At $6.0556   a gallon, diesel is about 14% more expensive than it was a month ago and over 60% more than a year ago.    That is starting to show up in other prices, as has long been feared; inflation data out Thursday showed  sharp spikes

伊朗说美国是最大干涉者和破坏者
伊朗外交部发言人巴加埃9月11日接受伊朗国家电视台采访时表示，美国一直是地区和平的最大干涉者和最大破坏者，“他们希望伊斯兰国家之间的动荡持续下去”。巴加埃表示，伊朗与地区各国之间的对话至关重要，地区国家需要依靠自身而不是外部力量来保障安全。
针对也门局势，巴加埃表示，也门当前发生的一切表明，也门民众的耐心已经耗尽，因为也门民众长期遭受残酷围困，被剥夺了一个正常国家应有的基本权益，他们认为联合国和区域机制无法改善局势，所以决定打破围困。（CCTV国际时讯）
